messages.content: 尋找Netflix上《六人行》的電視節目列表及其評分，以及Hulu上《我們的辦公室》和《怪奇物語》的評分，並按照評分排序。

function.name: streaming_services_shows_list_and_ratings
function.description: Get a list of shows and their ratings on specific streaming services. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

streaming_service.description: Name of the streaming service. E.g., Netflix, Hulu, etc.

show_list.description: List of show names to search for on the platform.

sort_by_rating.description: If set to true, returns the list sorted by ratings. Defaults to false.

We have a function streaming_services_shows_list_and_ratings that can retrieve list of shows and ratings on specific streaming services. We can call it twice: once for Netflix with show_list ["Six Feet Under"], sort_by_rating true; second for Hulu with show_list ["Our Office", "Stranger Things"], sort_by_rating true.

But the function signature expects streaming_service: string, show_list: string[], sort_by_rating?: boolean.

We need to call the function twice. The user didn't specify if they want the results sorted by rating across all shows or within each service. They said "and sorted by rating." That likely means within each service. So we can call with sort_by_rating true.
